rows.en:
I'm sorry.
He's always this unfriendly,
so please don't let it bother you.

Sheryl seems to be really looking forward
to school life this time around.
If you'd like, please be a good friend to her.

Well, I have work to get to,
so I'll be taking my leave now.
Okay, see you...

(Sheryl's manager and bodyguard, huh...
Brera-san was kinda unfriendly and scary,
but Grace-san seemed like a nice person.)

(Still, what were they talking about
in a place like this?)

(Well, no point worrying about it.
I'd better head back to class too.)

(Ever since Sheryl-san came to Mihoshi,
the whole school's been in an uproar...)

(But why did Sheryl-san transfer to Mihoshi
in the first place?)

(Could it be she read the message I sent...
No, there's no way.)
(Hm? I hear voices. What could that be?)

(The voices were coming from over here,
weren't they...)

(Huh?! Why is someone pointing
a knife at me?!)
(Ph-phew... I'm saved...)

Oh, you're Sheryl's manager?
I'm \p.
rows.notes: Bare 'Sheryl' here as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
So you're...
\p-san...
(She knows who I am?)
(No reaction...)

(Sheryl's manager and bodyguard, huh...
Brera-san was kind of unfriendly and scary,
but Grace-san seemed like a nice person.)

(Still, what could they have been talking
about in a place like this?)

(Well, no point worrying about it.
I'd better head back to class too.)

Whaaat?! You're not wearing it, Alto-kun?!
I just know it'd look great on you...
Ranka... not you too......

Ranka-chan's right.
Quit fussing and put it on, Alto.
I refuse!!

Wha-! The great Sheryl is asking you nicely,
and you've got the nerve to say no?!
rows.notes: kono Sheryl ga tanonde ageteru = 'I, Sheryl, am graciously asking'.

rows.en:
'Asking nicely,' my foot!
All you're doing is talking down to me!

U-um!
You two, please stop fighting...!

(I'd better leave the peacemaking here
to Ranka. Nobody can stop those two
anyway...)

(Okay, it's almost opening time.
I'd better get ready too.)

(I'd better leave the peacemaking here
to Ranka-chan. Nobody can stop those two
anyway...)

(Okay, it's almost opening time.
I'd better get ready too.)
I can't decide who to cheer for...

But if I cheer for everybody, no problem, right?
Go, everybody! Do your best!

Amazing, amazing! That's amazing,
\p-kun!
You really took first place!

Yeah! I'm gonna try to take first place too,
so cheer me on, \p-kun!
rows.notes: Follows her own line c23484 directly in the script; Ranka says she will compete for first place too (her event is not shown).

rows.en:
So close, \p-kun.
But you looked really cool running.
I hope you take first place next year.

You do understand, don't you? I, Sheryl Nome,
will NOT allow you to lose!
You'd better win, no matter what!!

Hmph! Of course you won.
I was the one cheering for you, after all.
Losing was simply out of the question.

Still...
I suppose you all did pretty well.
You've earned a little praise.

I cheered for you myself, and you lost...?
What do you all think you're doing?!

(Phew, Sports Day's finally over.
I'm beat, but it was exciting and really fun.)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
Amazing, amazing! That's amazing,
\p-chan!
You really took first place!

Yeah! I'm gonna try to take first place too,
so cheer me on, \p-chan!

So close, \p-chan.
But you looked really cool running.
I hope you take first place next year.

(Sheryl personally invited me to her concert
today... but is it really okay for me to be here?)

(When I showed my ticket at the reception desk,
for some reason they took me
to the dressing room...)
Oh, \p. So you came.

Of course!
Thanks for inviting me to your concert today,
Sheryl.

And sorry for barging in before the show.
When I showed my ticket, for some reason
they brought me all the way back here...

Well, of course they did.
I'm the one who told the staff
to bring you here.
Look, I called Alto and the others here too.

Oh, so Alto and the others got brought
to the dressing room too.

Seriously, it surprised me. We were headed
for our seats when all of a sudden they
showed us to the dressing room.

You could at least have told us ahead
of time, couldn't you, Sheryl-san?

But that'd be no fun!
I wanted to see Alto and the rest of you
all flustered like this.

Ngh! Sheryl!
Why, you...
Now, now, calm down, Alto.

Hehe, wanting to see your flustered faces
was only half a joke.
(Oh, so the other half was serious...)

I wanted to surprise everyone today.
That's why I invited you to my concert.

Actually, \p, I was planning to ask you
and the others to do EX-Gear acrobatics
as part of the concert's performance.

But in the end, today I wanted you
to watch my concert as audience members.
Hehe, you're going to be amazed.
Wow, so it's that amazing of a con......
rows.notes: Interrupted mid-word as in the Japanese. Shared male/female.

rows.en:
Sheryl-san!
What on earth is going on with Ranka-san?!

Oh, Nanase.
Thanks for coming to see my concert today.

N-not at all...
Thank you for inviting me...

...No, that's not the point!
Why is Ranka-san in your concert...?!
rows.notes: Nanase is cut off before spelling it out; kept vague so the reveal still lands.

rows.en:
Stop right there, Nanase.
It'd be no fun if you spilled it here, right?
Don't worry, Ranka-chan will do just fine.
(Hm? Did something happen with Ranka?)

Huh? Come to think of it, didn't you invite
Ranka to today's concert?
Of course I invited her! Obviously!

\p...
Do you take me for the wicked stepmother
who bullies Cinderella?
rows.notes: Nod to Ranka's title, Super Dimension Cinderella.

rows.en: Hmph, well, whatever...

Now then, the concert's about to start.
You and the others had better head
to your seats soon too, \p.
Yeah, I guess I will.
Enjoy my concert to your heart's content today!

You bet!
Well, good luck out there, Sheryl.

uncertain: c23485/c23493: 'I'm gonna try to take first place too, so cheer me on' follows Ranka's own congratulation directly; which event she enters is not shown in the scene.
c23518: Nanase's cut-off line kept vague ('Why is Ranka-san in your concert...?!') so the reveal still lands.
